missing: In-vitro thiamine-transport model (Caco-2 cells, recombinant hTHTR2): Zhang et al. 2014 Drug Metab Dispos, doi:10.1124/dmd.114.058883 (PMID 25063672) showed fedratinib inhibits thiamine uptake after the WE cases - a safety track, retrodiction: true, status retro (2014); the FDA review restates the ThTr1/ThTr2 assay (24.5%/44.2% at 300 uM).

Patient-derived JAK2V617F+ progenitor colony and xenograft model: Geron et al. 2008 Cancer Cell, doi:10.1016/j.ccr.2008.02.017 (PMID 18394555), TG101348 inhibited patient progenitor colonies and engraftment - an ex_vivo efficacy/engagement track (PV-derived cells) with no entry; BMS-911543 also inhibited CD34+ cells from JAK2V617F patients (cited in Pomicter 2015).

BMS-911543 on the same JAK2V617F BMT mouse track: Pomicter et al. 2015 Exp Hematol, doi:10.1016/j.exphem.2015.03.006 (PMID 25912019) found 'limited activity', no RBC effect and no allele-burden fall; NCT01236352 lists IWG best overall response as a PRIMARY outcome (results posted 2019-05-21), and Tefferi 2023 BCJ doi:10.1038/s41408-022-00780-9 reports 62% spleen response in 31 Mayo BMS-911543 patients. The draft's 'not scored/unsettled' needs an explicit entry or note.

BMS-911543 on JAK2V617F+ patient CD34+ progenitors (Purandare et al. 2012 Leukemia 26:280, cited by Pomicter 2015; DOI not verified): a member drug's run on the same ex-vivo progenitor system, could be an entry on track jak2v617f-patient-progenitor-colony; its trial outcome is a business stop.
rule_questions: BMS-911543: the mouse predicted limited activity (Pomicter 2015); NCT01236352 has IWG best overall response as a co-primary (3 PR/42 per draft) while a Mayo cohort reports 62% spleen response. Is this neg/same (limited model, limited IWG response, program stopped for business) or contra (patients' spleens responded) or unsettled because the stop was a business decision?

Fedratinib (Wernig, Gilliland lab) and NS-018 (Nakaya, Nippon Shinyaku) and BMS-911543 (Pomicter) used separately built JAK2V617F retroviral BMT mice; does 'one system' mean one model type (one model_id, as drafted) or one lab's system?

Should the rat/dog toxicology track carry a dose-cell entry (untested, unpublished) since its data set the FIH start but were public only in 2019, or is the dose cell correctly limited to the mouse track?

Safety contra for Wernicke's: the post-hoc rat thiamine study reached only 0.3x human AUC, and rodent chow is thiamine-replete - is WE a harm 'the species could have shown' at the exposures the tox package used?

Efficacy dating for single-arm trials: does an interim congress abstract that reports spleen response but not the registered primary (IWG best overall response) set the year (BMS-911543 ASH 2013), or only the first primary-endpoint result (registry 2019)?

Fedratinib mouse safety track: Wernig's 'no apparent toxicities' was followed by Wernicke's encephalopathy (2013 hold). Mice can develop thiamine-deficiency encephalopathy; should the mouse track take a contra entry, or is a short efficacy study not one that could show it?
